items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had one fellow around there. He played, but he played piano... Benton Overstreet, I think.

ctx.x: Well, back home beforeyou went to college, did you try playing any ragtime on the trumpet, or any musicians around there who wanted to play ragtime?

No, there wasn't any. I had one fellow around there. He played, but he played piano and he was doing -- what was he doing? Da-da-da-da -- Benton Overstreet, I think. Did you know -- did you ever hear of Benton Overstreet? I think Overstreet wrote that.
